Dear Madam
I do not think Mr Clare resembles [Mr Keble](../persons.html#798) at all.[^1] I certainly never should have consciously taken his portrait, I loved and honored him too much

yours truly
Charlotte M.

Yonge

[^1]: Mr Clare is a character in CMY\'s [The Clever Woman of the Family](../books.html#58) (1865).
